What picture is missing from the division model below?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129811/assets/9cc5d672cb3c12ceb7704f5136e9b7ecae61d11a9418acf3b8e1cbb9e8f044f7.png)
question.worked_solution:
Notice that in the model, we have $\dfrac{1}{3}$ on the left.

Since we need to divide by $\color{blue}3$, we split the whole into $\color{blue}3$ equal parts horizontally.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14129811/assets/30f9bbc604d35a9a15e1418c0cf80eca87fe4d704287c15fb8de7426eb9e3de9.png)

From the picture on the right, we obtain that the shaded part represents $\dfrac{1}{9}$ of the whole.

So, the missing picture is:
